identificationModule.briefTitle: Sargramostim, Vaccine Therapy, or Sargramostim and Vaccine Therapy in Preventing Disease Recurrence in Patients With Melanoma That Has Been Removed By Surgery
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Placebo-Controlled Phase III Trial of Yeast Derived GM-CSF Versus Peptide Vaccination Versus GM-CSF Plus Peptide Vaccination Versus Placebo in Patients With "No Evidence of Disease" After Complete Surgical Resection of "Locally Advanced" and/or Stage IV Melanoma

armGroups.label: Arm I (sargramostim, peptide vaccine)
armGroups.description: Patients receive sargramostim SC on days 1-14 and peptide vaccine comprising tyrosinase, gp100 antigen, and MART-1 antigen mixed with either incomplete Freund's adjuvant or Montanide ISA-51 VG SC on days 1 and 15 (course 1) and day 1 (course 2 and subsequent courses).

armGroups.label: Arm II (sargramostim placebo, peptide vaccine)
armGroups.description: Patients receive sargramostim placebo SC on days 1-14 and peptide vaccine comprising tyrosinase, gp100 antigen, and MART-1 antigen mixed with either incomplete Freund's adjuvant or Montanide ISA-51 VG SC on days 1 and 15 (course 1) and day 1 (course 2 and subsequent courses).

armGroups.label: Arm III (sargramostim, peptide placebo)
armGroups.description: Patients receive sargramostim SC on days 1-14 and peptide placebo mixed with either incomplete Freund's adjuvant or Montanide ISA-51 VG SC on days 1 and 15 (course 1) and day 1 (course 2 and subsequent courses).

armGroups.label: Arm IV (placebo, peptide placebo)
armGroups.description: Patients receive placebo SC on days 1-14 and peptide placebo on days 1 and 15 (course 1) and day 1 (course 2 and subsequent courses).

armGroups.label: Arm V (sargramostim)
armGroups.description: Patients receive sargramostim SC on days 1-14.

armGroups.label: Arm VI (sargramostim placebo)
armGroups.description: Patients receive sargramostim placebo SC on days 1-14.
